source.citation: Reece DE, Sullivan D, Lonial S, et al. Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic study of two doses of bortezomib in patients with relapsed multiple myeloma. Cancer Chemother Pharmacol 2011;67(1):57-67. doi:10.1007/s00280-010-1283-3 (author manuscript NIHMS551706, PMC3951913)

file_reviewed.file: nihms551706.pdf (18 pages, text layer; author manuscript)

source.storage: Supplied by the platform owner; kept on her computer only, not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted. Table 2 values transcribed from the layout text and checked against the rendered page; n per cell from the column headers and footnotes a-g. Independent review pending.

relationship_to_model: Not independent: Lignet 2022 compared its PK graphically with mean profiles from this study, and Kuan 2012 lists it as a source study. A comparison is a reproduction check (the data the model's authors used), not an outside check.

design.study: Randomized phase 1/2 study, bortezomib 1.0 or 1.3 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 4, 8 and 11 of 21-day cycles, relapsed myeloma (n = 21 per dose; 12 per dose evaluable for PK).

sampling.quote: prior to, and at 5, 15, and 30 min, and 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24, and 48 h following dosing on days 1 and 11, cycles 1 and 3
sampling.location: Methods, Pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic assessments, PDF page 4

auc48.quote: area under the curve (AUC) from time 0 to 48 h (AUC48h)

evaluable.quote: Patients who completed bortezomib dosing through day 11, cycle 3, without a dose modification, and who had sufficient samples for non-compartmental estimation of pharmacokinetic parameters were considered evaluable for these analyses.

table2.format: mean (SD); n from column header and footnotes

limits: Evaluable patients completed dosing through cycle 3 day 11 without dose modification, a selected subset.
